title: Inspector does not update resource data if the data is imported from json.
body: ### Tested versions v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6] ### System information MacOS Monterey 12.7.6 ### Issue description While I am working an addon: import data from json and save as resource file(.tres), the inspector shows the one which was loaded from the first time instead of the latest version which updated from json. I'd tried to delete (via Godot programatically and manually or terminal) and recreate the resource files, but the inspector's still showing the cached first loaded version. Data did updated if the changes are done via inspector. I have to reopen the godot to load the latest version resource files if I would like to update the resource data via json import. Or I have to open the resource file in terminal to confirm the data is updated. The settings from config file also do the same, the settings were updated while printing in output. Old settings were used while import. Until the addon was disabled, removed the config file in terminal, and then enable it again, settings will be updated. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Prepare the data from json (already in the zip file) 2. Import data via the importer 3. Load the resource data in inspector to confirm the data is imported 4. Change the resource data in json and save it 5. Import it again 6. Compare the data in terminal and inspector with json file PS: Importer UI is on the top right corner of Godot ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) [testing-project.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/21992516/testing-project.zip)
